# Apache HTTPD (HTTP) — root-to-custom-context-push-location

root-to-custom-context with upgrade allowed on the push paths only: `<Location /VAADIN/push>` maps to the backend's /app/VAADIN/push with `upgrade=websocket`, and the catch-all proxies plain HTTP.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Apache HTTPD config (`vaadin.conf`):

```apache
# Upgrade is allowed on the push paths only: each one gets its own block with
# upgrade=websocket, while the catch-all proxies plain HTTP.
# The root-to-custom-context sibling does the opposite and puts
# upgrade=websocket on the catch-all.
#
# Push sits at its default location: the browser asks for /VAADIN/push,
# which reaches /app/VAADIN/push on the backend. VAADIN_PUSH_URL cannot move it:
# the variable has been ignored since Flow 23 (issue #43).
#
# http:// with upgrade=websocket rather than ws://: since httpd 2.4.47 that
# upgrades only when the client asks for one, so the same block carries
# WebSocket, SSE and long polling. A ws:// worker serves WebSocket only, and
# SSE both streams from and POSTs its client-to-server messages to this path.
#
# ORDER MATTERS: mod_proxy shares a worker when one worker URL is a leading
# substring of another defined later, silently dropping the later one's
# parameters -- upgrade=websocket included. Longest backend URL first.

<Location /VAADIN/push>
    ProxyPass "http://vaadin:8080/app/VAADIN/push" upgrade=websocket
</Location>

<Location /HILLA/push>
    ProxyPass "http://vaadin:8080/app/HILLA/push" upgrade=websocket
</Location>

<Location />
    ProxyPass                  "http://vaadin:8080/app/"
    ProxyPassReverse           "http://vaadin:8080/app/"
    ProxyPassReverseCookiePath "/app" "/"
</Location>
```
